stories.title: Here today, gone to Bodmin: Town Crier Paul Haas receives most honorable welcome in Cornwall
stories.summary: You probably know official Town Crier Paul Haas as the voice of many events throughout the county, most notably during Cornish Christmas, local parades, and the St. Piran’s Day Pasty Toss. He also is a well-known personality on local radio…

stories.title: Never too late to help the hungry: Food Bank of Nevada County enlisting folks for neighborly food drives
stories.summary: Did you know that September is officially declared as Hunger Action Month? Since the first of the month, agencies throughout the country have been rallying the troops, so to speak, to encourage donations toward those experiencing food insecurity.

stories.title: The county’s history, now at the touch of your fingertips
stories.summary: Nearly 200 years of county records are now available to access online with ease. The Nevada County Historical Society has been hard at work digitizing close to a million pieces of local history.

stories.title: Roller-skate night in Grass Valley to support local veterans
stories.summary: Another fun roller skating nighttime event is planned for Saturday, September 26, from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. at the Grass Valley Veterans Memorial Building located at 255 South Auburn Street in Grass Valley.

stories.title: Bruins sweep Mira Loma in three straight sets
stories.summary: The Bear River Lady Bruins girls varsity volleyball team (17-2, 5-0 league) continued its dominant run in a home game Monday night, sweeping the Mira Loma Matadors (0-6, 0-5 league) in three straight sets, 25-8, 25-12 and 25-12.

stories.title: BriarPatch Food Co-op: Lord of the wings
stories.summary: Necessity is the mother of invention, as they say, which explains a lot about chicken wings. Historically, wings have been a less prized part of the chicken, with breast meat hogging the glory and thighs getting plenty of love, too.…

stories.title: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet
stories.summary: The US and China are vying for AI supremacy while seeking to keep it under human control.
